description: Reviewed input-mass parity exclusions for the UK terminal battery, scoped per named comparison reference (microcosm#630): an exclusion suppresses only when its reference is the armed one, so a column excluded on a channel-blind reference is compared normally against a channel-aware one with no register change. Each entry is a complete approval receipt (schema-2 fields per #610). The gate reports dormant entries, FAILS stale ones, and FAILS expired ones until the adjudication is renewed, so this register cannot rot.
